retryMax.description:
If it's zero, the agent will not retry the target function.
If it's not zero, the failure of target function will initiate correcting the spec by LLM.
And it keeps retrying the correction and executing the target function until executing successfully
or reaching either this retry max or the #retryTimeoutSec.

retryTimeoutSec.description:
When the retry was initiated, the agent will retry to execute and correct the spec until
executing successfully or reaching either the #retryMax or this timeout.

NOTE: this time does not include the initial attempt.

promptTemplateReflexionAgent.description: The prompt used to correct the eval spec during the retry process.

llmModelNameReflexionAgent.description: The LLM model used to answer the question. Must correspond to a {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig}.

llmConfig.description: Config used to specify the LLM that should be used for generation of the Spec.

templatePrompt.description: Prompt sent to the spec generation model to produce the spec to answer a question.

templatePromptBuilder.description: The instance in charge of building the prompt.

excludeDocumentationInPrompts.description: Whether to exclude the type/field documentations in the prompt

overrideSpec.description:
If it exists, then skip spec generation and use it as the input of fuzzy matching.
This is used by retrying correction and executing {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.StructuredDataQuery.Base#generateSpec}.

nExamples.description:
The number of few-shot examples to insert into the spec generation prompt. Set this value to 0 to not include examples or -1
to disable the retriever and fetch all examples.

userLabel.description: The label to use for the user in the formatted output during few-shot retrieval formatting.

assistantLabel.description: The label to use for the assistant in the formatted output during few-shot retrieval formatting.

generateTextKwargs.description:
Arguments to send to {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig#generateText} when generating text
after using few-shot retrieval. This is important to prevent the LLM from indefinitely generating
user and assistant conversation on its own. The stop sequences should match the user and assistant
labels. The 'stop' key might differ per LLM deployment, E.g. different for OpenAI, MIS, etc.

title: Base Spec to be used in generating an {@link EvalSpec} or {@link EvalMetricSpec} using llm
